speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Defence (a) whether any form of ragging is allowed in SAF; and (b) whether ragging or the carrying out of any activity associated with ragging constitutes part of the recognised duties of any SAF officer, specialist, instructor or personnel.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Each activity is clearly outlined with safety measures and limits, with an approved Safety Management Plan with a Supervising Officer, Conducting Officer and a Safety Officer present throughout.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: For all activities, the safety of individual soldiers is paramount, and Commanders must take corrective measures to mitigate risks to their soldiers, where necessary.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Similarly, unit orientation activities can only be conducted if authorised and not endanger the well-being of any serviceman.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: These requirements that I have just spelt out are consistent with the core values of SAF and are known to Commanders.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: In 2012, an SAF vehicle overturned during an exercise which caused the death of a soldier.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The officer was found to have committed a rash act and attempted to pervert the course of justice.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: SAF soldiers are encouraged to report any unauthorised activity or punishment.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: New recruits are specifically briefed on how they can do so.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: They can either report it through their unit superiors or contact the MINDEF Feedback Unit.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: It is an easy number to remember, 1800 367 6767.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: And there are SAF Safety Hotlines for the Army, Navy and Air Force  .

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: I have listed them in my reply to be distributed to the press, as well as recorded in the Hansard so that people will know these numbers and they know that they can report any unauthorised activity or punishment.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Every complaint is investigated fully and those caught doing wrong will be prosecuted.
